name: cli-terminal
purpose: The Azion CLI band of a product page: a horizontal section title with one outlined button, over a terminal on the pixelate texture that runs off the frame's bottom rule. The terminal is either a recorded Azion CLI session typed live by a `product-widget` (`script`), in a fixed-height stage that rises in when it scrolls into view, or a static session whose lines enter one after another (`session`). It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'cli-terminal', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `button`, `frame-box`, `texture-material`, `product-widget` and `code-block`.
useWhen: Use CliTerminal only on marketing pages for a full-width terminal session.
To close a product argument on how little it takes to ship from the terminal, like Functions and Workloads.
avoidWhen: For a config file or handler beside the claim → use `media-split-band` with `codeTabs`.
For several capabilities, each with its own file → use `feature-scroll` with code items.
related: code-block` — the terminal session the band shows.
media-split-band` — the sibling band with the sample (`codeTabs`) beside the copy.
bestPractices: Keep the session to a few commands and their output; comment the output lines so the copied text still runs.
Name the copy button with `copyAriaLabel` so a screen reader says what it copies.
Prefer `script` on a product page: `start` types the first-project session, `deploy` the deploy session. Use `session` for a command set the recordings do not cover.
Set `anchor` when a hero button scrolls to this band.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the horizontal section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: script
props.doc: Recorded Azion CLI session the terminal types live: `start` or `deploy`; wins over `session`.

props.name: session
props.doc: The terminal session shown under the header when no `script` is set, commands and their output verbatim, highlighted as bash; the band renders nothing when neither is set.

props.name: copyAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the session's copy button; empty keeps the code block's own.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Outlined button in the section title; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CliTerminal from '@aziontech/webkit/cli-terminal'

  const session =
    'azion link --preset javascript --name auth-handler --auto\n# Project successfully configured\n\nazion deploy --auto\n# Upload completed successfully!\n# Your Application was deployed successfully\n# Domain: https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net\n\ncurl https://k7q2fmx4ze.map.azionedge.net/\n# Hello World'

  const primaryAction = {
    label: 'Install the CLI',
    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/azion-cli/overview/',
    trailing: true
  }
</script>

<template>
  <CliTerminal
    eyebrow="Azion CLI"
    title="Deploy your first function in two commands"
    description="Link a project, deploy it, and curl the domain the CLI hands back. Builds run on your machine with --local, or on Azion."
    :session="session"
    copy-aria-label="Copy the deploy session"
    :primary-action="primaryAction"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Script
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CliTerminal from '@aziontech/webkit/cli-terminal'

  const primaryAction = {

    href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/documentation/products/azion-cli/overview/',

</script>

<template>
  <CliTerminal
